title: Locals protest outside Manipur Chief Minister's residence in Imphal over killings

tea.why: Locals protested after three individuals were killed in an ambush by suspected militants.
tea.want: Action over fresh killings and violence.
tea.changed: Oct 19: Police fired tear gas shells to disperse protesters who left a body outside the Chief Minister's residence.

summary: Following a suspected militant ambush along the border of Imphal East and Kangpokpi districts that left three people dead and others injured, angry residents staged a protest in Imphal on October 19, 2026. Protesters brought bodies of the victims and left them outside the residence of Manipur Chief Minister Y Khemchand Singh. Security personnel deployed at the location responded by firing multiple rounds of tear gas shells to disperse the crowd. Officials stated that the bodies were subsequently taken to the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences.
demands: Action regarding the killings of civilians by suspected militants
response: Security personnel deployed at the Chief Minister's residence used tear gas shells to disperse the demonstrators and subsequently moved the bodies to the Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Medical Sciences, according to reports.

updates.text: Locals placed bodies outside the Manipur Chief Minister's residence in Imphal to protest against fresh killings.
Security forces used tear gas to disperse the protest and transferred the bodies to JNIMS.

sources.title: 3 killed in fresh clash in Manipur, angry locals leave body outside CM's residence
